reference_sql:
WITH store_units AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, units,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM store_units
)
SELECT store_code, product_id, units
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
WITH store_units AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
),
best AS (  -- one row per store with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, MAX(units) AS units
  FROM store_units
  GROUP BY store_code
)
SELECT su.store_code, MIN(su.product_id) AS product_id, su.units
FROM store_units su
JOIN best b ON b.store_code = su.store_code AND b.units = su.units
GROUP BY su.store_code, su.units

SELECT t.store_code, t.product_id, t.units
FROM (
  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1

solver.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY store_code, product_id),
r AS (SELECT store_code, product_id, units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC, product_id) AS place FROM p)
SELECT store_code, product_id, units FROM r WHERE place <= 1
